title: Make a three-ring paper chain
description: Link three paper rings into one chain that holds when you lift an end.
oneStarDescription: Glue or tape one paper ring.
twoStarDescription: Pass each new ring through the last before you close it.
threeStarDescription: Lift one end and show the other rings follow.

title: Mark a vertical with string
description: Hang a string with a small weight and mark a vertical line beside it.
oneStarDescription: Hang it so the weight can rest still.
twoStarDescription: Wait until it stops swinging.
threeStarDescription: Mark a line beside the string and say it is vertical only while the string hangs free.

title: Mark stage left from the stage
description: Stand on a practice stage and mark the side that is your left as you face the audience.
oneStarDescription: Face the side you are calling the audience.
twoStarDescription: Mark that side as stage left.
threeStarDescription: Walk to the audience side and say that their right is your left.

title: Match a key to an outline
description: Draw the outline of a key and match the key back to that drawing among two outlines.
oneStarDescription: Draw one key's outline. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can draw it.
twoStarDescription: Draw or place a second different outline.
threeStarDescription: Match the key to the right outline without looking at a label.

title: Match steps with a partner
description: Walk beside a partner and match their step length for a short distance.
oneStarDescription: Start on the same step, with the same foot they use.
twoStarDescription: Walk beside them and keep the same pace.
threeStarDescription: Stop when they stop, on the same step.

title: Mime a heavy box
description: Pick up an imaginary box so a watcher can tell it is heavy.
oneStarDescription: Reach for the box with both hands.
twoStarDescription: Change your body so the weight reads.
threeStarDescription: Set it down and leave it there.

title: Mime a wall
description: Show an imaginary wall by touching it in three places a watcher can follow.
oneStarDescription: Touch one high point and hold it so a watcher can see where the wall starts.
twoStarDescription: Touch two side points at the same distance.
threeStarDescription: Ask a watcher where the wall is.

title: Mirror-write your name
description: Write your name so it reads correctly in a mirror.
oneStarDescription: Write the mirrored name.
twoStarDescription: Hold it to a mirror and read it.
threeStarDescription: Rewrite one letter that failed the mirror.

title: Move a bean with chopsticks
description: Move one bean from one dish to another with chopsticks.
oneStarDescription: Pick up one bean and hold it.
twoStarDescription: Move it to the other dish without using the other hand on the bean.
threeStarDescription: Set it down where you aimed.

title: Move hanging foil
description: Hang two small foil pieces and show them move when a charged comb comes near.
oneStarDescription: Hang two light pieces so they can swing.
twoStarDescription: Charge a dry comb. Leave the result where a watcher can see it.
threeStarDescription: Bring the comb near and say what the foil did.

title: Move one match in a figure
description: Move one match in a drawn or stick figure so the figure matches the goal you stated.
oneStarDescription: Write what the figure should become.
twoStarDescription: Move only one match or stick.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the goal is met.

title: Make a hand shadow someone can name
description: Make a hand shadow and ask someone to name the animal or object before you tell them.
oneStarDescription: Cast one shape on a wall.
twoStarDescription: Ask what they see before you say the name.
threeStarDescription: If they cannot tell, change one finger and ask again.

title: Name the missing card
description: Look at twelve cards of one suit, see one removed, and name it.
oneStarDescription: Lay the cards in order. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can lay the suit.
twoStarDescription: Look away while one card is removed.
threeStarDescription: Name the missing card, or say you are not sure.

title: Name the strum direction
description: Strum once downward and once upward and say which was which.
oneStarDescription: Strum toward the floor and name it.
twoStarDescription: Strum toward the ceiling and name it.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone which way the last strum went.

title: Note the car you boarded
description: Note the car or carriage you entered so you can find an exit or a companion.
oneStarDescription: Read the letter or number on the car.
twoStarDescription: Write it down or say it to the person you are with.
threeStarDescription: From the platform side or a note, point back to that mark.

title: Open a jar with a better grip
description: Open a jar you are allowed to open, using a cloth or a grip, and say what worked.
oneStarDescription: Try the lid and say whether it moved.
twoStarDescription: Use a dry cloth or a gripper and try again.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it opened, and leave a stuck jar for someone else rather than forcing a glass lip.

title: Open an envelope without tearing the letter
description: Open an envelope and take out a paper without tearing that paper.
oneStarDescription: Open the flap, or slit only the envelope.
twoStarDescription: Slide the paper out. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can remove the letter.
threeStarDescription: Show the letter whole and the envelope apart.

title: Put one suit in order
description: Lay one suit face up and put it in order from low to high.
oneStarDescription: Separate one suit from the deck.
twoStarDescription: Put the cards in order. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can order the suit.
threeStarDescription: Read the run aloud and stop if a card is missing.

title: Shuffle a small deck overhand
description: Shuffle a small deck with an overhand shuffle and square it.
oneStarDescription: Move packets from one hand to the other.
twoStarDescription: Square the deck so no card sticks out.
threeStarDescription: Deal five cards and say whether they stuck together.

title: Pack a cylinder so it does not roll
description: Pack a cylinder in a box so it does not roll when you tip the box a little.
oneStarDescription: Tip the loose cylinder and see it roll.
twoStarDescription: Add paper or a divider so it stays.
threeStarDescription: Tip the box a little and say whether it rolled.

title: Palm a coin and show the hand
description: Hide a coin in the palm, show the hand as empty to a person you told, then produce the coin.
oneStarDescription: Place the coin so the palm holds it.
twoStarDescription: Show the hand, then bring the coin out.
threeStarDescription: Tell the watcher where it was.

title: Pass a ball around your waist
description: Pass a ball around your waist and back to the start without a drop.
oneStarDescription: Move the ball around once.
twoStarDescription: Show the handoff behind your back.
threeStarDescription: Go back the other way once.

title: Pass a cat's cradle
description: Hold a cradle so a partner can take it onto their hands.
oneStarDescription: Show a stable cradle. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can offer the figure.
twoStarDescription: Keep the tension while they take it.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the figure survived on their hands.

title: Pass a cup behind your back
description: Pass a plastic cup from one hand to the other behind your back without a drop.
oneStarDescription: Move the cup behind you into the other hand.
twoStarDescription: Bring it forward still upright.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it stayed upright.

title: Pass an imaginary object
description: Pass an imaginary object to a partner so they receive its size.
oneStarDescription: Shape the object in your hands.
twoStarDescription: Hand it over and let go.
threeStarDescription: See whether they keep the same size, and say what changed.

title: Peel in one strip
description: Peel an orange or a similar fruit in one strip if the peel allows, or say where it broke.
oneStarDescription: Start one continuous strip.
twoStarDescription: Peel as far as the strip holds.
threeStarDescription: Show the strip and the point it broke, or the whole peel.

title: Peg three items to three pictures
description: Attach three items to three fixed pictures and recall the items from the pictures.
oneStarDescription: Choose three pictures you will reuse.
twoStarDescription: Link one item to each picture with a vivid pair.
threeStarDescription: Look at the pictures and say the items.

title: Pick up a clip with a nail coil
description: Wrap wire around a nail, connect a battery briefly, and see whether the nail picks up a clip.
oneStarDescription: Wrap insulated or carefully handled wire around the nail.
twoStarDescription: Touch the battery and try to lift one clip, then disconnect.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the clip dropped when you disconnected, and stop if anything feels warm.

title: Pin a cape so it releases
description: Pin a cloth at the shoulder with a safety pin you can undo quickly.
oneStarDescription: Pin two layers. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can pin the cloth.
twoStarDescription: Turn once and say whether it held.
threeStarDescription: Undo the pin and show the cloth free.

title: Pin a temporary hem
description: Pin a hem so it holds for a try-on and can be removed without a tear.
oneStarDescription: Fold the edge to the length you want.
twoStarDescription: Pin it so the pins stay on the inside.
threeStarDescription: Take the pins out and show the cloth is not torn.

title: Play a note on a blade of grass
description: Make one tone with a blade of grass or a leaf held to the lips.
oneStarDescription: Produce one tone a person nearby can hear.
twoStarDescription: Change how you hold it and say what the tone did.
threeStarDescription: Stop and drop the grass where you may.

title: Play three keys in a named order
description: Name three piano keys, play them in that order, and stop.
oneStarDescription: Point to the three keys first.
twoStarDescription: Play them in the order you named.
threeStarDescription: Lift your hand and show you finished.

title: Pop a folded paper popper
description: Fold a paper popper, swing it once, and say whether it popped.
oneStarDescription: Fold the popper so the pocket can open.
twoStarDescription: Swing it beside you, not toward a face.
threeStarDescription: Say whether you heard a pop.

title: Pour to a marked line
description: Pour water to a marked line and stop at the line.
oneStarDescription: Point to the line before you pour.
twoStarDescription: Pour and stop at the line, at eye level.
threeStarDescription: Say whether you passed the line and how you would correct it.

title: Put a key on a ring
description: Open a split ring and put one key on it, then show the key stays.
oneStarDescription: Start the key onto the split.
twoStarDescription: Slide the key fully onto the ring.
threeStarDescription: Tug the key and show it does not come off.

title: Read a boarding pass
description: Find the gate, the seat, and the boarding time on a pass or a sample.
oneStarDescription: Point to the seat. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can find the seat.
twoStarDescription: Point to the gate, or say the pass does not show one yet.
threeStarDescription: Point to the boarding time and say what it is not, such as arrival.

title: Read a measuring cup at eye level
description: Read a line on a measuring cup with your eye level with the line.
oneStarDescription: Put the cup on a flat surface.
twoStarDescription: Crouch or lift the cup so your eye is at the line and read it.
threeStarDescription: Say what you would misread if you looked from above.

title: Read a dreidel face
description: Spin a dreidel and read the letter that lands on top.
oneStarDescription: Point to the four letters before you spin.
twoStarDescription: Spin it on a table. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can spin it.
threeStarDescription: Read the letter facing up when it falls.

title: Read a line upside down
description: Read a printed line that is upside down to you, without turning the page.
oneStarDescription: Read one line aloud while it stays upside down.
twoStarDescription: Point to a word someone names.
threeStarDescription: Turn the page and correct any word you missed.

title: Read a locker label
description: Match a locker number to a key or a ticket.
oneStarDescription: Read the number on the key or the ticket.
twoStarDescription: Find the matching door. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can find the door.
threeStarDescription: If it does not open, stop and say you will ask, rather than forcing it.
